name: The Latin Chef Liberty Station
notes: 3 photos: photo 2 is a laminated menu page (Appetizers/Peruvian Soups/Seafood). Photo 3 is a laminated page with hand-corrected current prices for Chicken/Beef/Vegetarian/Drinks/Dessert; those corrected prices superseded the older wall-banner prices for the same Beef/Chicken items seen in photo 1, so photo 1 was treated as duplicate/outdated and not re-added. Chaufa de Quinua's description was partly blacked out on the menu and omitted.

dishes.name: Salchipapa
dishes.description: Sliced and fried hot dog served with french fries.

dishes.name: Yuca Frita
dishes.description: Fried cassava served with huancaina sauce on the side.

dishes.name: Platanos Fritos
dishes.description: Fried plantains.

dishes.name: Peruvian Salad
dishes.description: Lettuce, tomatoes, onions, black Peruvian olives, and slices of boiled eggs in a Peruvian style dressing.

dishes.name: Leche de Tigre
dishes.description: A refreshing sauce of fresh fish and shrimp marinated in lime juice.

dishes.name: Papa a la Huancaina
dishes.description: Creamy sauce made of aji amarillo and queso fresco served on a bed of boiled potatoes, garnished with slices of hard-boiled eggs, lettuce, and Peruvian olives.

dishes.name: Anticuchos (Peruvian Style Kabobs)
dishes.description: Grilled and skewered pieces of beef heart marinated in aji panca and Peruvian spices. Served with grilled potatoes.

dishes.name: Ceviche de Pescado
dishes.description: Fresh white swai fish marinated with freshly squeezed lemon juice and rocoto. Served with yams, corn, and red onions.

dishes.name: Ceviche de Camaron
dishes.description: Shrimp marinated with freshly squeezed lemon juice and rocoto. Served with yams, corn, and red onions.

dishes.name: Chupe de Camarones
dishes.description: A hearty shrimp soup with vegetables, potatoes, corn, egg, and milk cream.

dishes.name: Parihuela
dishes.description: A Peruvian seafood soup with codfish, aji panca, and ginger.

dishes.name: Arroz con Mariscos
dishes.description: Rice with seafood (Paella style) shrimp, mussels, calamari, and octopus.

dishes.name: Pescado Frito
dishes.description: Pan fried swai fish fillet served with rice and salad. May also be served steamed.

dishes.name: Pescado a la Chorrillana
dishes.description: Chorrillo style swai fish filet pan fried or steamed topped with red onions and tomatoes sautéed with Peruvian spices. Served with rice.

dishes.name: Tallarin Saltado Seafood
dishes.description: Open flame sautéed shrimp, slices of octopus, calamari, onions, tomatoes, and noodles.

dishes.name: Arroz Chaufa Seafood
dishes.description: Peruvian Chinese style fried rice with seafood, scrambled eggs, green onions, cilantro, and soy sauce.

dishes.name: Pescado a lo Macho
dishes.description: Filet of fish pan fried or steamed topped with a special sauce made of shrimp, calamari, and octopus served with rice.

dishes.name: Picante de Mariscos
dishes.description: Shrimp, calamari, and octopus in a delicious creamy tomato sauce. Served with rice and slices of boiled potatoes.

dishes.name: Seafood Saltado
dishes.description: Open flame sautéed seafood with red onions, french fries, and tomatoes served with rice.

dishes.name: Jalea
dishes.description: Variety of fried seafood and fish. Served with yuca, fried potatoes, sarza, and aji dipping sauces.

dishes.name: Arroz Chaufa de Pollo
dishes.description: Peruvian Chinese style fried rice with pieces of chicken, green onions, scrambled eggs, and soy sauce.

dishes.name: Pollo Saltado
dishes.description: Open flame sautéed chicken with red onions, tomatoes, cilantro, and french fries served with rice.

dishes.name: Tallarin Saltado de Pollo
dishes.description: Open flame sautéed strips of chicken, red onions, tomatoes, and noodles.

dishes.name: Tallarines Verdes con Pollo
dishes.description: Fried chicken breast tossed with noodles in a Peruvian style pesto sauce made of basil and pecans.

dishes.name: Arroz Chaufa de Carne
dishes.description: Peruvian Chinese style fried rice with pieces of beef, green onions, scrambled eggs, and soy sauce.

dishes.name: Lomo Saltado
dishes.description: Open flame sautéed strips of meat with red onions, tomatoes, cilantro, and french fries served with rice.

dishes.name: Tallarin Saltado de Res
dishes.description: Open flame sautéed strips of beef, red onions, tomatoes, and noodles.

dishes.name: Tallarines Verdes con Bistek
dishes.description: Top sirloin steak tossed with noodles in a Peruvian style pesto sauce made of basil and pecans.

dishes.name: Bistek a lo Pobre
dishes.description: Top sirloin steak, french fries, fried plantains, and a fried egg. Served with white rice and a small fresh salad.

dishes.name: Arroz Chaufa de Tofu
dishes.description: Peruvian Chinese style fried rice with pieces of tofu, green onions, cilantro, scrambled eggs, and soy sauce.

dishes.name: Tallarin Saltado de Tofu
dishes.description: Open flame sautéed strips of tofu, red onions, tomatoes, and noodles.

dishes.name: Tallarines Verdes con Tofu
dishes.description: Tofu tossed with noodles in a Peruvian style pesto sauce made of basil.

dishes.name: Inka Cola
dishes.description: Peruvian national carbonated drink.

dishes.name: Chicha Morada
dishes.description: Made out of purple corn and flavorful spices.

dishes.name: Lucuma Ice Cream
dishes.description: Tropical Peruvian fruit characterized for having a dry and sweet pulp.
